text:
Zara (People Ops): Quick heads-up: launching a short "International Benefits Parity" handbook refresh. Focus: align parental leave language for APAC/EU hires, clarify stipend eligibility for contractors converting to FTE, and add a documented escalation path for accommodation requests. Required micro-training (10m) + 3-question quiz due Sep 20. Tracker link in sheet.

Omar (Global Benefits): Link please? Also want a note about country-level top-ups.

Zara (People Ops): Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/int-benefits-parity. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/int-benefits-parity-sep2026

Leah (Legal): Reviewed the redline. I tightened the wording on "start date" vs "hire date" for staggered offers and added jurisdictional exceptions for statutory leave.

Priya (Recruiting): We'll need to update offer templates where we reference parental leave accrual. I'll queue PRs for US/EU/APAC variants. For candidates already extended offers, are terms grandfathered?

Zara (People Ops): Yes, changes are prospective; offers accepted before the publish date keep prior terms. Added that sentence to the confluence doc.

Nate (Eng Manager): Can managers get an export of completion for their direct reports? Some of my ICs are contractors converting next month and I want to verify they saw the stipend change.

Zara (People Ops): LMS will flag completions. Managers can request a CSV export via the tracker under "Export requests" and we'll run it daily.

Omar (Global Benefits): Stipend note: contractors converting within 30 days of offer will be eligible for the one-time equipment stipend; conversions after that follow normal enrollment windows. Added to benefits notes.

Leah (Legal): I added an FAQ blurb on contractor-conversions and a short sample manager response for inquiries.

Priya (Recruiting): Thanks  I'll add a checklist item to the offer flow to flag stipend eligibility and leave language.

Nate (Eng Manager): Office hours for managers? I might want a quick script for 1:1s.

Zara (People Ops): Yup  two slots Tue 9am and Tue 4pm, 20m each. RSVP in the sheet. Manager script and slide deck uploaded under "Manager assets".

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: employees missing training will get nudges Sep 6, Sep 13, and final on Sep 18 (status: queued).

Omar (Global Benefits): One more ask: can we include a short section on payroll timing for stipend disbursements (pay-cycle dependent)? Some EMEA finance teams asked.

Zara (People Ops): Added payroll timing note in the confluence page and linked to Finance FAQs.

Nate (Eng Manager): Great. I'll tell my leads to run the export after Sep 20 and follow up on any incompletes.

Leah (Legal): Recommend we also include the legal Q&A in next week's HR drop and tag regional leads. I'll paste a short Q&A in the sheet today.

Zara (People Ops): Perfect. Final reminders: training due Sep 20, manager confirmations of review by Sep 24. Add any 1:1 requests in the tracker. :calendar:
__notes: Single Slack thread summarizing an international benefits parity handbook refresh, training deadline, manager resources, offer template changes, and tracker logistics. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender display names.
